displayName: OCI-AI-VEC-001: AI — Vector DB — Pinecone Namespace Isolation Bypass
description:
Detects cross-namespace data access in Pinecone vector database

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — vector db — pinecone namespace isolation bypa

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_vec_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%vector%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%pinecone%') AND "value" > 0
